description:
*Fichero* processes large collections of digitized documents—hundreds or even tens of thousands—by cropping, enhancing, segmenting, transcribing with AI, and auto-cataloguing. It outputs results to Word and Excel files.

You can [learn more](https://www.tubb.ca/fichero/) about how this is done, if you're interested, but the short version is that Fichero uses various tools to break down each step, calls out to Vision Large Language Models, and runs on various folders in parallel.

To start, choose a folder to process using the button above.
about_acknowledgments:
[Fichero](http://www.tubb.ca/fichero/) transcribes and auto-catalogues historical archives using vision large language models and artificial intelligence, running locally or in the cloud.
